body:
Text index updates previously scanned unchanged source rows and rebuilt retained index metadata. This change maintains independent source identity and coverage, probes changed subjects, and updates shared persistent index and surface tables. Certified normalized source directories support sealing, compaction, regrouping and resident-head changes without retaining predecessor source owners.

The segmented image uses the documented profile-4 layout, and text generation identities are versioned for the new source/index identity laws.

The repository-wide WASM audit removes 312 of 359 focused WASM case executions and three semantic-only workflow jobs. The 47 retained executions cover platform dispatch/SIMD, shadow-stack/host interfaces and frozen native identities. Geographic replay selects frozen digest records with exact-selection enforcement. Ordinary native coverage is preserved. AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and WASM_TESTING.md document the boundary, and docs/agents/ holds the linked Rust guidance.

Native source metadata reserves exact row/checkpoint counts, reuses the physical directory when annotations do not require normalization, omits the implicit zero checkpoint and hashes scalar terms without traversal scratch. Measured SHACL product admission falls from 303 to 293 allocations. Fixed-batch preparation falls from 44 allocations / 4,977 requested bytes to 36 / 4,121 at all three corpus sizes, with lower retained/peak memory and unchanged update/clone counts. Serialized directory bytes and source identities are preserved.

Validation completed before the cull: 1,396 core library tests, three directory tests, 15 source-observer tests, 365 text tests across 33 result groups, and strict all-target checks for hash/core/text/shapes. After the allocation optimization, focused native checks pass for admission counts, checkpoint boundaries, directory sharing, original retained-memory/refund behavior, all three directory and 15 source-observation cases. The resource test passes independent fresh-index parity and allocation/read/memory growth controls for lexical/Han configurations at 128, 4,096 and 16,384 documents. Final core/shapes all-target Clippy passes with warnings denied. The interrupted local WASM attempt is not passing evidence; no new WASM execution or full runtime matrix is claimed.

Hosted qualification exposed stale capacity-proof identities/locations, four byte accesses outside the shared byte-codec pattern, and a stale surface-assembly measurement symbol. Repairs preserve record offsets/widths and the existing proof and assembly constraints. The actual shared-helper gate now passes all 87 enforced jobs and 120 distinct groups; affected core/all-target Clippy passes with warnings denied. Normal commit hooks remain mandatory. Revised hosted assembly, remaining CI and final integration review are pending; no merge claim is made.

The assembly graph also compiles the existing surface benchmark, which supplies a real caller for the generic substring body without executing benchmarks. Baseline x86_64 assembly and document parity pass all 112 sites; the stale phonetic setup cell was regenerated from that measurement. The other six assembly configurations remain subject to hosted qualification. On the preceding allocation head, all five integration shards and the native test/conformance aggregates passed; two RISC-V jobs reached their 30-minute limit without a reported test failure, so those jobs still need completed qualification.

Closes #683.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added source-change observations that report added and removed RDF rows, along with content fingerprints and statement counts.
  * Added duplicate-sensitive 256-bit multiset tracking.
  * Text and surface indexes now support incremental updates, including removing documents from a surface index.
* **Improvements**
  * Text-index fingerprints account for duplicate source rows while remaining independent of row order.
  * Annotation queries now return matching annotations.
  * Incremental text-index updates validate changes against independently observed source data.
* **Testing**
  * WebAssembly test coverage is now focused on selected platform-specific cases; broad test jobs and cases were removed.
* **Documentation**
  * Added Rust engineering guidance and updated documentation on WebAssembly testing and index behavior.
